 Advocate for : MS M HAZARIKA  Advocate for : PP  ASSAM appearing for THE STATE OF ASSAM AND ANR  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHIVJYOTI SAIKIA
Heard Ms. M. Hazarika, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. D. Khan, learned counsel for the applicant.
Also heard Mr. K. K. Das, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam.

2. This application has been filed praying for correction of the cause title of the connected Criminal Petition No.633/2025.
3.
The said Criminal Petition has been filed under Section 482 of the Cr.PC, whereas it should have been 528 of the BNSS, 2023.

Similarly in paragraph Nos. 1 and 19 of the application the term Section 482 of the Cr.PC has been referred to, whereas it should have been 528 of the BNSS, 2023.
4.
5. Henceforth, the phrases Section 482 of the Cr.PC appearing in the entire application shall be read as Section 528 of the BNSS, 2023.

This order shall form a part of the Criminal Petition No.633/2025.
7.
